limitations: Do not infer Initial Access from the first observed execution.

Auto-start LocalSystem service points to javamtsup.exe; same path later launches from services.exe as SYSTEM.
limitations: Configuration and later execution share host/path/service context rather than ProcessGuid.

limitations: Exact privilege-acquisition mechanism is not fully reconstructed; do not claim a specific UAC bypass from RunAs alone.

evidence_basis: SDelete removed the initial .scr and later Rar.exe; hidden/encoded PowerShell and image-based payload extraction are directly observed.
limitations: Artifact deletion does not prove complete anti-forensic success.

limitations: Successful credential extraction is not shown; certificate theft did not succeed in the reviewed event.

limitations: Independent Zeek logs are not time-aligned and cannot corroborate these exact events; successful interactive C2 is not independently demonstrated.

evidence_basis: Collection/staging and outbound communications exist, but no sender/receiver object, transferred-file hash or outcome proves staged data left the environment.
limitations: Traffic alone is insufficient to claim exfiltration.

limitations: Technical compromise is established, but business/ATT&CK Impact-stage consequences are not.
